user: Fine. Back to that charge — what do I do next? First state its exact transaction ID, amount and reason code. Do not open a dispute.
answer:
What I did: I reviewed your account transactions and the eligibility check we ran earlier.

What I found:
- Transaction ID: TX-0401  
- Amount: EUR 240.00  
- Reason code: service_not_rendered

What happens next:
1. Contact the merchant first and request proof of shipment/delivery or a refund. Keep copies/screenshots of the order confirmation, tracking/delivery records, and any correspondence — these are the evidence Verta may ask for.  
2. If the merchant does not resolve it, tell me and I will open a dispute for you. Before filing I will re-run the eligibility check and only proceed if it returns eligible; I will file under reason_code = service_not_rendered if you instruct me to open it.  
3. Note: if a dispute is opened and Verta requests supporting evidence, failure to provide it within 7 calendar days may cause the case to be declined.

I will not open a dispute now, per your instruction. Tell me if you want a draft message to the merchant or want me to proceed with a dispute later.

fragments.text:
Dispute handling process
## Evidence requirements
The customer may be asked for supporting evidence: an order confirmation, a
delivery record, correspondence with the merchant. Failure to supply requested
evidence within 7 calendar days results in the case being declined.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Glossary
## Provisional credit
A temporary refund applied while a dispute is reviewed; reversed if the dispute
is declined.

Glossary
## Settled transaction
A transaction the merchant has claimed and Verta has debited. Only settled
transactions can be disputed.
